title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Status Terms: Ladders, Mid-Year Upgrades and the Annual Review
content:
**Ladders.** Card status of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards moves only within a network's ladder: Store Card, Store Card Plus, Store Card Elite on the private-label ladder, and Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard on the co-brand ladder. The Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard is held by application only and never changes status. A status upgrade is made only from a card listed as an upgrade source of the higher status.

**Calendar-year card spend.** The spend a status is measured on is the Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to the card, less the Marlowe & Finch refund credits posted to it, by transaction date within one calendar year, 1 January through 31 December (the current year to date when evaluated mid-year). Each status's threshold is that card's calendar-year card spend figure in the program schedule.

**Upgrade during the year.** As soon as the calendar-year card spend for the current year reaches the figure of a higher status on the same ladder, the account moves to the highest status reached within 3 business days.

**Annual review.** On January 15 each year the status for the new year is set to the highest status of the ladder whose figure the previous calendar year's card spend meets, or to the ladder's base card when none is met; this is the only occasion on which a status moves down.

**Account condition.** The account is in active status, as the company's account record shows. A restricted account keeps its current status until it is reinstated and the next review runs.

**What a change leaves untouched.** Status changes never change the credit line, APR or card number.

## Cases (hypothetical spend, figures of the program schedule)

| Account | Spend event | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Store Card | current-year spend reaches USD 600.00 in June | moves to Store Card Plus within 3 business days |
| Store Card | current-year spend jumps from USD 500.00 to USD 1600.00 with one purchase | moves to Store Card Elite, the highest status reached |
| Store Card Elite | previous-year spend USD 700.00, review on January 15 | set to Store Card Plus |
| Platinum Mastercard | previous-year spend USD 2000.00, review on January 15 | set to Mastercard, the ladder's base card |
| Store Card, restricted | current-year spend reaches USD 600.00 | keeps Store Card until reinstated and the next review runs |
| World Elite Mastercard | any spend | no change |
